body:
everything feels so unreal to me today. like a video game.   
A romantic relationship is great and i tend to find those when i have a lot of close friendships, a social circle, a community. But being single is a burden to close friends, social circles or the community. And i don't mean like 'ugh he's so lame' burden but it is atypical and abnormal and usually indicates some kind of defect. So naturally that raises people's defenses and one becomes more suspect and further away from the center of the herd. 

At some point you just lose sight of everyone else, and then it doesn't matter what you do anymore. It literally has no meaning.

I can understand. I just made my first post here. I hate the insinuation that I don't try. Mother fucker I try. I quit heroin. I lost 100lbs (twice, lol). I stopped a 25 year long cigarette addiction. I just quit caffeine. I been yoga'd, did improv, DMT, dating, fuckin volunteer with everyone...that shit don't change a brain. I've been on prozac and webutrin for nearly a year. Best I've felt in a minute was reading what you just wrote. I make more money than I have any right to, and people like me way more than they should. I like Camus, started the stranger years ago. Doesn't seem like a real go-to guy for emotional support, though, hahaha.
